correctness.rationale: The structural premise is Theorem 8 of Horváth–Lángi. For a regular \(m\)-gon, a pair of sidelines with normals separated by \(2q\pi/m\) intersects at radius \(R\cos(\pi/m)/\cos(q\pi/m)\), so every and only the allowed odd \(q\) gives a homothetic extension. The illumination parameter is the area of an explicit tangent triangle minus the intervening polygonal cap, which simplifies to the claimed \(\delta_{m,q}\). The embedded convex-hull checker independently reproduces finite cases but is not used as an all-\(m\) proof.
